traditional: No classical doctrine: Pluto is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Expansion meets power. Large-scale ambition, intense conviction, and a drive to overhaul inherited beliefs. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Conviction hardens into zealotry or overreach. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.waxing: Crisis of action: take conscious hold and build a durable form for growth against power, or be thrown off course.
cyclic.waning: Crisis of meaning: break down the growth/power form that has outlived its purpose and reorient toward the next cycle.

business: Friction in this area. Big, transformative ambition; the intensity can overshoot.
shadow: Excess and overreach collides with control and obsession; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: Friction builds toward a forced adjustment.
arcSeparating: The crisis passes; what was restructured settles.

readerCopy.summary: A celebrated expansion concentrates more money and influence inside the institutions already strong enough to set the terms.
readerCopy.body: A celebrated expansion concentrates more money and influence inside the institutions already strong enough to set the terms. A merger, funding round, or market win is presented as opportunity while workers, competitors, and smaller participants lose access. Jupiter enlarges the reach and confidence, while Pluto tightens control over who can benefit. The square makes every sign of growth increase the power imbalance hiding underneath it. The numbers may look impressive while the system becomes harder to challenge from anywhere outside the winning structure.
